resources.string: If connecting a wallet does nothing, run a test here, then copy or share the log with us. It shows each step: the wallet app found, the request sent, the session and the answer. No keys or full addresses are logged.
No Solana wallet app found on this device. Install Phantom or Solflare.
No app to share the log with
Connect a wallet first (Today → Connect wallet), then I can read your SKR balance.
SKR lives on Solana mainnet, and this wallet is on a test network, so there is no SKR to read.
I couldn\'t read your SKR balance just now. Try again in a minute.
You have %1$s SKR. If you want to stake it, the official page is stake.solanamobile.com (Season tab → Stake SKR).

Reads the official Solana Mobile blog and docs. X support is built in and turns on with the paid API.
Perks are as the partner announced them. Find the apps in the Solana dApp Store. Solarchik never promises points.

Everything in Solarchik works on any Android phone. If you own a Seeker, verify it with its Seeker Genesis Token for a Verified badge and +%1$d secretary minutes a day. You sign a sign-in message in your wallet; no transaction, nothing is paid.
Your Seeker Genesis Token (%2$s) is verified: +%1$d secretary minutes a day. One token gives this perk to one account.
No Seeker Genesis Token in this wallet. That\'s fine: everything keeps working. On a Seeker, connect the Seed Vault wallet that holds it.
This Seeker Genesis Token was already used by another account, so the perk stays there.
